title: Content-space edits — pixel tools before the geometry tail
objective: Pixel-stage edits address the source after EXIF orientation and are inserted before quarter-turns, reflections and the crop, so changing the crop never moves or invalidates an edit; the canvas pick and a core query map a view point to that content coordinate.
context_summary: Accepted by the owner on 2026-09-20 for immediate implementation. The host chooses a new layer's position from its declared effect stage: pixel effects insert before the first geometry layer, geometry effects append. The renderer's meaning of a layer's coordinates (its input stage) is unchanged, so existing stacks render identically and no stored shape changes. Planning validates and samples the stage at the insertion index. The desktop pick and the proposed render.locate query map an output pixel back through the geometry tail to a content pixel. Specs, feature status and the user guide are updated in the same work. Every crates change answers the performance checklist.

tasks.description: Place a committed pixel-stage layer before the geometry tail in the host, and give plan a content-stage sampler.
extra_context: Add the insertion rule to the snapshot/recipe API beside append and with_layer_replaced: insert at the index of the first layer whose effect stage is geometry, else append. The host derives the stage from the registry's effect descriptor; a layer whose effect has no provider already fails before this point.

Extend StageContext with the insertion index for a Commit of the acting effect's stage and a sampler over the stack prefix before that index. Reuse the existing per-segment evaluation so planning still allocates no frame.
Keep Update semantics and the whole-stack compile before persisting. Do not change recipe validation to reject interleaved stacks.

acceptance_criteria: A pixel-stage Commit on a stack ending in transforms and a crop inserts before the first geometry layer; on a stack with no geometry it appends; geometry Commits still append.
The StageContext reports the insertion stage and samples the prefix stack; sampling the output stage is still available for modules that need it.
History entries, layer identities, immutable earlier snapshots, no-op detection, request deduplication and the whole-stack compile behave as before.
Performance checklist answered: no new frame allocation in planning, one recipe clone per commit as today.

steps: Unit tests on recipe insertion for empty, geometry-only, pixel-only and mixed stacks, including a stack with an existing interleaved pixel layer after geometry.

Editor tests proving a pixel edit after a crop lands before it, renders exactly at angle zero and matches the resample reference at a nonzero angle, and that a subsequent crop move, grow and shrink keep the same content pixel edited and are never rejected because of it.
expected_results: All existing core tests pass unchanged except those that asserted append-only placement, which are updated to the new rule.
Exact-buffer proofs pass for the crop journey with a preceding pixel edit.

tasks.description: Map an output-stage point to a content coordinate in the core and expose it as the render.locate query.
extra_context: Walk the compiled segments backwards: exact geometry unmaps by integer inverse; a resample maps the output pixel center to fractional input coordinates that round to the nearest input pixel; a point outside any stage is a validation error.
Method shape: render.locate {asset_id, entry_id?, x, y} -> {content_x, content_y}. It reads only; it never commits or changes session state. Add it to the host method table and schema.list.
